# Getting help

## Adoption enquiries

Contact the animal's shelter directly through its own website. The
[shelter register](../data/shelters.yaml) lists institutional websites and
contact details, including when the Posvoji.si site is not publicly accessible.
Posvoji.si indexes listings; it does not handle adoptions.

Za posvojitev se obrnite neposredno na zavetišče prek njegove spletne strani.
[Seznam zavetišč](../data/shelters.yaml) vsebuje njihove uradne kontakte.

## Contributing and reporting problems

Use the [issue forms](https://github.com/fresh55/posvoji/issues/new/choose) for
bugs, ideas, development questions, new shelters and data corrections.
Slovenian and English are both welcome. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
for setup and pull request guidance.

For vulnerabilities, private reports or removal requests containing personal
data, follow [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md). Ordinary issues are not confidential.
